GENERATE BURST KS-travel-pulsed-01 — E1 arm A: the "PULSED" TRAVEL key state of the fire bolt, painted over the runtime's own travel frame (Run C-5, E1 arm A "painted key states"; S1 § 2b conditions: fixed canvas, original state in every call, a tooling guide, ONE change per call). task_id "KS-travel-pulsed-01".

IMAGE 1 is the fire bolt's REST travel drawing as the runtime composes it (head P01 + streak P02 on a 512×512 transparent canvas, travelling to the RIGHT) — the identity. IMAGE 2 is the TOOLING GUIDE: the same composition at a later instant of flight (the head swollen a quarter larger and the streak shortened and thickened (a pulse mid-flight)) on the same canvas — the SHAPE CONTRACT. IMAGE 3 is the scale + register board (130-px figures = 1 BH; hand-drawn contour).

Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 2 and deliver ONE 512×512 image with a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background: IMAGE 2 RE-PAINTED so that it reads as one drawn frame of a fire bolt in flight — the head as a fat bright core with its tongues flared, the streak short and heavy, the whole body reading as a surge of heat — while the head and the streak stay exactly where IMAGE 2 puts them (silhouette within ~4 px of the guide; nothing added, removed or moved). Keep the vocabulary of IMAGE 1 exactly: GREYSCALE ONLY, exactly FOUR flat value planes with hard edges, the same line weight, no gradients/glow/blur/colour, no ground, sparks, smoke, motion blur or text. ONE change: re-drawing the composition as a coherent painting.

One image_gen call. ONE retry only if: the silhouette departs from the guide, the background is not clean, gradients/glow/soft edges or more than four planes appear, or the line weight changed — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/travel_pulsed_01.png with sha256 (no conversion, no trim). No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "KS-travel-pulsed-01"): files = [exactly one entry: out/travel_pulsed_01.png with its sha256]; images = the INTEGER COUNT of image_gen calls made (1 or 2) — NOT a list, NEVER a path under $CODEX_HOME/generated_images; calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS with concerns listed honestly (state whether the output has real transparency).
